We are growing fast across both commercial health systems and federal healthcare, and our ambient documentation platform is scaling to thousands of clinicians across hundreds of specialties.

We are at an inflection point where advances in language models and clinical AI can fundamentally change how clinicians interact with technology. That gives them more time to focus on what matters most: their patients.
